01-plate-worded.text: Create a rectangular plate 100 mm long, 60 mm wide and 10 mm thick.

02-cylinder-axis.text: Create a cylinder 20 mm in diameter and 50 mm tall along the +Z axis.

03-box-dimensional.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm box.

04-plate-centre-hole.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with a 20 mm diameter through hole in the center.

05-plate-two-holes.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with two 16 mm diameter through holes.

06-cube-bore.text: Create a 50 mm cube with a 20 mm diameter cylindrical hole through the center.

07-plate-chamfer.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate and chamfer the vertical edges by 2 mm.

08-plate-fillet.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate and fillet the vertical edges with a 2 mm radius.

11-sphere.text: Create a sphere with a 20 mm diameter.

12-union.text: Create a cylinder and a box joined together.

B6-plate-subtract-cylinder.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate. Create a 20 mm diameter cylinder 10 mm tall standing at the centre of the plate, and subtract that cylinder from the plate.

D1-plate-hole-chamfer-long-edges.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with a 20 mm diameter hole through the centre, then chamfer the four long edges by 2 mm.

F1-drilled-plate-round-corners.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with a 20 mm diameter hole through the centre, then round the four outside corners with a 5 mm radius.

F2-hole-rim-chamfer-top.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with a 20 mm diameter hole through the centre and break the top edge of the hole with a 1 mm chamfer.

F3-hole-rim-chamfer-bottom.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate with a 20 mm diameter hole through the centre and break the bottom edge of the hole with a 1 mm chamfer.

G1-subtract-then-chamfer.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate. Create a 20 mm diameter cylinder 10 mm tall at the centre of the plate and subtract it. Then chamfer the four long edges of the plate by 2 mm.

G2-two-holes-then-chamfer.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate. Drill a 20 mm diameter hole through its centre, drill a 10 mm diameter hole through the point 20 mm from the left-hand edge on the centreline, and then chamfer the four long edges by 2 mm.

G3-two-tool-subtract.text: Create a 100 mm by 60 mm by 10 mm plate. Create two 16 mm diameter cylinders 10 mm tall, one 25 mm from the left-hand edge and one 75 mm from it, both on the centreline, and subtract both of them from the plate in one operation.

H4-threaded-rod.text: Create an M8 threaded rod 40 mm long with a proper helical thread.

I1-underspecified-plate.text: Create a mounting plate with some holes in it.
